_comment: 创伤知情教育模拟。依据民法典第1010条、妇女权益保障法、现行治安管理处罚法以及随附裁判文书与典型案例重构；性骚扰、猥亵、强制猥亵的定性取决于具体事实，全部文本待公益律师校对。

title.en: What to Do When Someone Is Sexually Harassed
title.zh: TA被性骚扰了该怎么做

tagline.en: Seven realistic settings — balance safety, records, support, organisational action, and legal options without grading survival responses.
tagline.zh: 七种现实情境——练习在安全、记录、支持、单位处理与法律路径之间作出判断，不给求生反应打分。

intro.en: These paths are adapted from judgments and official case materials, with names and details combined and anonymised. No option guarantees detention, filing, compensation, dismissal, or access to CCTV. Nothing you choose is saved.
intro.zh: 这些路径参考判决与官方案例材料，但人物和细节均经过合并、匿名化处理。任何选择都不保证拘留、立案、赔偿、处分或取得监控；你的选择也不会被保存。

narration.en: Which situation would you like to practise?

coach.en: The legal label may change with the conduct, relationship, setting, age, and degree of coercion. This exercise focuses on practical decisions, not predicting a judgment.
coach.zh: 具体行为、关系、场所、年龄和强制程度不同，法律定性也可能不同。本练习关注现实决策，不预测裁判结果。

text.en: Message harassment — work chat becomes persistent sexual contact
text.zh: 文字骚扰——工作聊天变成持续性信息

text.en: Workplace — comments, unwanted contact, and fear of retaliation
text.zh: 职场——言语、触碰与报复担忧

text.en: Recruitment — an interview moves into a private setting
text.zh: 招聘——面试被临时改到封闭空间

text.en: Street — sexual comments from a stranger at night
text.zh: 公共道路——夜间陌生人的性暗示言语

text.en: Public place — sudden touching or indecent conduct
text.zh: 公共场所——突然触碰或猥亵

text.en: Acquaintance — coercion inside a car or other enclosed space
text.zh: 熟人——车辆等封闭空间中的强迫

text.en: A minor discloses private contact by a teacher or other adult
text.zh: 未成年人透露被老师或其他成年人单独接触

narration.en: A work contact has shifted from normal messages to repeated sexual remarks and images. Some messages are withdrawn after you do not reply. You want the contact to stop, and reopening the chat is distressing.
narration.zh: 一名工作联系人从正常沟通转为反复发送性暗示言论和图像；你没有回复后，对方又撤回了部分信息。你希望联系停止，也不愿反复打开聊天。

text.en: Ask a trusted person to help preserve the profile, full thread, timestamps, and withdrawal notices, then block
text.zh: 请可信任的人协助保存账号页、完整上下文、时间和撤回提示，再拉黑

feedback.en: This reduces repeated exposure while preserving context. The helper should avoid unnecessary forwarding.
feedback.zh: 这样既减少你反复接触内容，也尽量保留上下文；协助者应避免不必要的转发。

text.en: Capture recent messages and the account name, block now, and decide about a fuller backup later
text.zh: 先保存近期信息和账号名称，立即拉黑，之后再决定是否补充完整备份

feedback.en: Immediate distance can matter. A partial capture may omit earlier context, so note what may still exist.
feedback.zh: 先拉开距离可能很重要；但局部截图可能缺少早期上下文，可记下还可能存在什么。

text.en: Mute and archive the chat overnight, without replying, so you can decide when someone is with you
text.zh: 先静音并归档，不回复，等有人陪伴时再决定下一步

feedback.en: Waiting for support is valid. Muting is different from deleting; you do not have to reopen the chat alone.
feedback.zh: 等待支持是合理选择。静音不等于删除；你不必勉强自己独自重开聊天。

narration.en: The person contacts you from another account and hints that refusing them could affect your work reputation. You have not decided whether to involve the employer, platform, or police.
narration.zh: 对方换账号继续联系，并暗示拒绝可能影响你的工作名声。你还没有决定是否联系单位、平台或公安机关。

text.en: Report both account identifiers to the platform and save the submitted text, confirmation number, and result
text.zh: 把两个账号标识一并提交平台，并保存投诉内容、受理编号和处理结果

feedback.en: A platform report creates one traceable record but does not guarantee account action.
feedback.zh: 平台投诉能形成一条可追踪记录，但不保证平台采取特定措施。

text.en: Notify the relevant employer or client in writing and ask that future contact use a shared work channel
text.zh: 书面告知相关单位或客户，并要求今后的工作沟通改用有他人在场的公共渠道

feedback.en: This asks for a practical boundary and records when the organisation was notified. Keep a copy outside the work account.
feedback.zh: 这既提出实际边界，也记录单位何时知情；副本应保存在工作账号之外。

text.en: Speak with 12338, 12348, or a lawyer first and plan the safest order for preservation, blocking, and reporting
text.zh: 先向 12338、12348 或律师咨询，再安排留存、拉黑和投诉的安全顺序

feedback.en: Advice before action can be useful where employment or retaliation risks are involved.
feedback.zh: 当事情涉及工作和报复风险时，先咨询再行动可能更稳妥。

narration.en: A supervisor has repeatedly made sexual comments, invited you to meet alone, and used unnecessary physical contact. A manager previously called it a joke. You still need the job and worry that a complaint may affect shifts or evaluations.
narration.zh: 一名上司反复发表性暗示言论、要求单独见面并有不必要的身体接触。此前有管理人员称这只是玩笑。你仍需要这份工作，也担心投诉会影响排班或考核。

text.en: Build a dated timeline from messages, meeting records, locations, and what each witness actually observed
text.zh: 根据消息、会议记录、地点和证人实际所见，整理带日期的事实时间线

feedback.en: Separate direct observation from later hearsay. Preserve originals and do not ask witnesses to agree on one version.
feedback.zh: 应区分亲眼所见与事后听说；保留原件，也不要让证人共同商量统一说法。

text.en: Ask for a private HR conversation, then send a factual same-day email summarising what you reported and what HR said would happen
text.zh: 先与 HR 私下谈，再于当天发送事实性邮件，确认自己反映了什么、HR 承诺如何处理

feedback.en: A conversation can be a first step; the follow-up email makes the notification easier to trace.
feedback.zh: 口头沟通可以是第一步；随后邮件能让通知和单位回应更容易追踪。

text.en: Consult a union, 12338, 12348, or a lawyer before using the internal channel, and preserve permitted personal copies
text.zh: 先向工会、12338、12348 或律师咨询，再使用内部渠道，并保留允许留存的个人副本

feedback.en: Planning first may help where power imbalance or retaliation is a concern. Do not take unrelated confidential company data.
feedback.zh: 存在权力差和报复担忧时，先做计划可能更合适；不要带走与事件无关的单位机密。

narration.en: The organisation proposes informal mediation. Soon afterwards, your schedule or evaluation changes. The stated reason is business need, but the timing worries you.
narration.zh: 单位提出先做非正式调解。随后你的排班或考核发生变化，单位称是业务需要，但时间上的接近令你担忧。

text.en: Ask in writing for the complaint receipt, investigator, timeline, interim separation, confidentiality limits, and non-retaliation measures
text.zh: 书面询问投诉回执、调查人员、预计时间、临时隔离安排、保密边界和防报复措施

feedback.en: The law addresses organisational prevention, complaint handling, investigation, and action; the exact measure remains case-specific.
feedback.zh: 法律涉及单位的预防、受理投诉、调查处置义务；具体措施仍取决于个案。

text.en: Preserve the before-and-after schedules, evaluations, messages, and stated reasons, then get advice before alleging retaliation
text.zh: 保存变化前后的排班、考核、消息和单位理由，再咨询如何判断是否属于报复

feedback.en: Timing alone does not prove retaliation, but contemporaneous records can help assess the pattern.
feedback.zh: 时间接近本身不能证明报复，但同期记录能帮助专业人员判断是否存在模式。

text.en: Accept a temporary transfer for distance, but confirm that it is voluntary and does not close the complaint
text.zh: 为拉开距离先接受临时调岗，但书面确认这是自愿的，且不代表撤回投诉

feedback.en: A temporary arrangement may support safety without requiring you to surrender the complaint.
feedback.zh: 临时安排可以先改善安全，而不必放弃投诉；应明确内容和期限。

narration.en: A recruiter moves an interview from an office to a hotel room, saying an important client meeting makes this convenient. They imply the industry is small and declining could affect future opportunities.
narration.zh: 招聘者把面试从办公地点改到酒店客房，称临时要见重要客户，这样更方便；又暗示圈子很小，拒绝可能影响以后机会。

text.en: Ask to meet in the lobby or another public area and keep the written invitation and change of location
text.zh: 要求改在大堂或其他公共区域见面，并保留邀请与改地点的消息

feedback.en: A public setting reduces isolation and preserves the response to a reasonable boundary.
feedback.zh: 公共场所能减少被隔离风险，也会留下对方如何回应合理边界的记录。

text.en: Have a trusted person wait nearby, share the room and hotel details, and agree on a check-in time
text.zh: 让可信任的人在附近等候，共享房间和酒店信息，并约定确认安全的时间

feedback.en: A check-in plan can create an outside timeline and a faster route to help.
feedback.zh: 确认安全的计划能形成外部时间线，并缩短求助路径。

text.en: Go to the meeting but send the address and recruiter's profile to a friend after arriving
text.zh: 先去赴约，到达后再把地址和招聘者资料发给朋友

feedback.en: Sharing details helps, but doing it only after entering leaves a period when no one knows where you are.
feedback.zh: 共享信息仍有帮助，但进入后才发送，会留下无人知情的时间段。

narration.en: Inside, the recruiter blocks the easy route to the door, threatens to spread rumours, and makes unwanted sexual contact. You are calculating how to leave without escalation.
narration.zh: 进入后，对方挡住顺畅通往门口的路线，以散布谣言相威胁，并做出不受欢迎的性接触。你在判断如何避免升级并离开。

text.en: Keep the interaction calm until there is a route out, then go to staff or a populated area and contact the person expecting your check-in
text.zh: 先维持平静，出现离开机会后前往工作人员或人多处，并联系等待确认安全的人

feedback.en: Appeasing or acting normal to escape is a survival response, not consent. Safety comes before an admission.
feedback.zh: 为脱身而顺从或表现平静是求生反应，不等于同意；安全优先于取得对方承认。

text.en: Use the phone's emergency feature if safe, move toward the corridor, and ask a named staff member to stay with you
text.zh: 如安全可行，使用手机紧急功能，向走廊移动，并明确请一名工作人员陪同

feedback.en: A specific request is easier to act on and may create staff and access records.
feedback.zh: 向具体人员提出明确请求通常更容易得到响应，也可能形成工作人员和出入记录。

text.en: Keep the phone recording and press for an explicit admission before trying to leave
text.zh: 继续录音，并先追问对方明确承认，再尝试离开

feedback.en: A recording can seem valuable, but prolonging confrontation in an enclosed space can increase danger. Evidence is never an obligation.
feedback.zh: 录音看似重要，但在封闭空间延长对质可能增加危险；受害者没有义务为了证据继续停留。

narration.en: You are outside. Potential records include interview messages, hotel registration and access data, corridor video, staff observations, and calls or locations shared with a trusted person.
narration.zh: 你已经离开。可能存在的记录包括面试消息、酒店登记和出入信息、走廊监控、工作人员所见，以及向可信任者发送的通话或定位。

text.en: Make a record map with times and locations, preserve the interview messages, and promptly ask the hotel how records can be retained
text.zh: 按时间和地点整理记录清单，保存面试消息，并尽快询问酒店如何留存相关记录

feedback.en: The hotel may not release records directly, but an early request helps identify what authorities or counsel can seek.
feedback.zh: 酒店未必会直接向个人提供记录，但尽早请求有助于确认哪些材料可依法调取。

text.en: Report with a support person and provide the invitation, hotel trail, staff locations, and names of people who knew where you were
text.zh: 由支持者陪同报案，并提供邀请记录、酒店线索、工作人员位置和事先知情者名单

feedback.en: Whether conduct is treated as harassment, indecent assault, or another offence depends on coercion and the full facts.
feedback.zh: 行为属于性骚扰、猥亵、强制猥亵还是其他情形，取决于强制程度和完整事实。

text.en: Get medical or psychological support first, preserve actual records and receipts, and decide about reporting with advice
text.zh: 先获得医疗或心理支持，保留实际病历和票据，再在咨询后决定是否报案

feedback.en: Care is valid regardless of reporting. Records should reflect real treatment and expenses.
feedback.zh: 无论是否报案，获得照护都是正当的；病历和票据应反映真实治疗与支出。

narration.en: Late at night, a driver blocks your path and makes a sexual proposition while displaying cash. When you raise your phone, the driver changes the explanation and begins to leave.
narration.zh: 深夜，一名司机挡住你的去路，展示现金并作出带有性意味的询问。你举起手机后，对方改口并准备离开。

text.en: Move toward a lit, staffed place while recording the vehicle, plate, time, and direction from a safe distance
text.zh: 向明亮且有人值守处移动，同时从安全距离记录车辆、车牌、时间和方向

feedback.en: This combines distance with identifiers. Do not approach the vehicle for a clearer image.
feedback.zh: 这样兼顾距离和身份线索；不要为了更清晰的画面靠近车辆。

text.en: Call a trusted person on speaker, share your location, and describe the vehicle as you move away
text.zh: 边离开边给可信任的人打免提电话、共享位置并描述车辆

feedback.en: A live contact supports safety and may create a contemporaneous witness to what you said and where you were.
feedback.zh: 实时联系人既能支持安全，也可能成为你当时说了什么、身在何处的同期证人。

text.en: Keep the camera on and ask the driver to repeat the exact words before leaving
text.zh: 继续录像，并让对方在离开前重复刚才的话

feedback.en: A repetition may capture content, but extending direct engagement can increase unpredictability.
feedback.zh: 让对方重复可能记录内容，但延长直接互动也会增加不确定性。

narration.en: The vehicle has left. You have some combination of video, a partial plate, a call record, location history, nearby cameras, and a trusted person who heard from you that night. You later feel anxious and consider care.
narration.zh: 车辆已经离开。你可能掌握视频、部分车牌、通话记录、定位、附近监控，以及当晚听你讲述的可信任者。之后你感到焦虑，也在考虑就医。

text.en: Keep the original media unchanged, make a separate backup, and write what is certain and what remains uncertain
text.zh: 保持原始媒体不变，另做备份，并分别写下确定记得与仍不确定的内容

feedback.en: Separating memory from uncertainty is more useful than repeatedly editing one narrative.
feedback.zh: 区分确定与不确定内容，比反复修改同一份叙述更可靠。

text.en: Make a police report with the available identifiers and ask what receipt, decision, or evidence-submission list applies
text.zh: 携现有身份线索报案，并询问可取得何种回执、决定或材料提交清单

feedback.en: A report does not guarantee a penalty, but process records can matter if video or a vehicle must be identified later.
feedback.zh: 报案不保证处罚，但如后续需要识别车辆或调取监控，程序记录仍可能重要。

text.en: Seek care for the anxiety and preserve the clinical record, payment receipt, and any advice about time away from work
text.zh: 因焦虑寻求照护，并保留病历、缴费凭证和有关休息或误工的医嘱

feedback.en: Courts assess actual treatment, expense, and lost-work evidence separately. A diagnosis does not guarantee an amount.
feedback.zh: 法院会分别审查真实治疗、费用和误工证据；诊断并不保证特定赔偿数额。

narration.en: In a crowded public place, a stranger suddenly touches an intimate area and says it was accidental. The person moves toward an exit. Nearby people saw only fragments.
narration.zh: 在人多的公共场所，一名陌生人突然触碰你的隐私部位，并称只是意外，随后向出口移动。周围人只看到了片段。

text.en: Move toward staff or security and ask one specific bystander to stay and say only what they personally observed
text.zh: 向工作人员或安保移动，并请一位具体旁观者留下，只陈述其亲眼所见

feedback.en: A witness need not see everything to help establish time, place, movement, or your immediate reaction.
feedback.zh: 证人不必看见全部过程；时间、地点、人员移动和你当时的反应也可能有证明作用。

text.en: Leave by the safest staffed exit, note the person's appearance and direction, and write the details once away
text.zh: 从最安全且有人值守的出口离开，记住对方外貌和方向，脱离后再写下细节

feedback.en: Leaving safely remains valid even if the person is not immediately stopped.
feedback.zh: 即使因此无法当场拦住对方，安全离开仍是正当选择。

text.en: Alert staff through an emergency channel and give the location, direction, and description without following alone
text.zh: 通过紧急通话装置或其他渠道通知工作人员，说明位置、方向和外貌，不独自追赶

feedback.en: Specific venue details may help narrow cameras and exits even if staff did not see the contact.
feedback.zh: 即使工作人员没有看到触碰，具体区域和出口信息也可能帮助缩小查找范围。

narration.en: Staff ask what you want them to do. Cameras may overwrite, and witnesses are beginning to leave. You are unsure whether police, venue records, or later civil advice will matter most.
narration.zh: 工作人员询问你希望他们怎么处理。监控可能被覆盖，旁观者也在陆续离开。你不确定公安处理、场所记录或后续民事咨询哪项最重要。

text.en: Ask staff to record the incident, preserve relevant camera ranges, and note witness contacts while available
text.zh: 请工作人员登记事件、留存相关时段监控，并趁证人尚未离开记录联系方式

feedback.en: A prompt request identifies possible records; availability and retention still vary.
feedback.zh: 尽快提出请求有助于确认可能存在的材料，但是否存在及保存期限仍有差异。

text.en: Report with the venue, time window, direction, witnesses, and staff incident number; review the statement before signing
text.zh: 报案时提供场所、时间段、方向、证人和工作人员登记编号，并在签字前核对笔录

feedback.en: Police records, statements, video, and administrative decisions may later corroborate a civil claim, but no item guarantees an outcome.
feedback.zh: 公安记录、陈述、视频和行政决定可能在后续民事程序中相互印证，但任何单一材料都不保证结果。

text.en: Get support first, keep existing records safe, and later ask about police or civil options without assuming one universal deadline
text.zh: 先获得支持并妥善保存现有记录，之后再咨询公安或民事路径，不自行假定只有一个统一期限

feedback.en: Different procedures and claims have different time rules. A local service can assess the conduct and dates.
feedback.zh: 不同程序和请求适用的时间规则不同，应由本地合格服务结合行为和日期判断。

narration.en: An acquaintance drives to an isolated area, locks the car, ignores requests to stop touching and kissing you, and prevents you from leaving. You briefly have access to your phone.
narration.zh: 一名熟人把车开到偏僻处，锁住车门，无视你要求停止触碰和亲吻的表达，并阻止你离开。你短暂拿得到手机。

text.en: Send a short pre-agreed help message or live location to family, then keep the phone unobtrusive
text.zh: 向家人发送预先约定的简短求救信息或实时位置，再把手机放到不引人注意处

feedback.en: A short signal can be safer than a detailed message and gives responders a location and timeline.
feedback.zh: 简短信号可能比详细说明更安全，也能向救援者提供位置和时间线。

text.en: Act calm and say what is needed to lower tension while watching for an exit, people, or a moment to call
text.zh: 为降低冲突先表现平静，同时观察出口、人群或可以拨打电话的时机

feedback.en: Strategic compliance is a survival response, not agreement. You are not responsible for failing to resist physically.
feedback.zh: 策略性顺从是求生反应，不等于同意；没有身体反抗并不是你的责任。

text.en: Use the phone to seek an admission before contacting anyone else
text.zh: 先用手机追问并争取对方承认正在做什么，再联系其他人

feedback.en: Signalling evidence collection can increase danger or cause records to be destroyed. Help and exit come first.
feedback.zh: 暴露取证意图可能增加危险或促使其销毁记录；求助和脱离优先。

narration.en: You are now safe. Possible records include the rescue call, location history, vehicle and route information, injuries, medical visits, and the first person you told.
narration.zh: 你现在已安全。可能存在的记录包括求救通话、定位、车辆和路线、伤情、就医记录，以及最先听你讲述的人。

text.en: Seek care, photograph visible injuries if you choose, and keep original medical records, receipts, and work-leave advice
text.zh: 按健康需要就医；如本人愿意可拍摄可见伤情，并保留原始病历、票据和休息医嘱

feedback.en: Medical care is for health first. In a later claim, actual records and expenses are assessed item by item.
feedback.zh: 就医首先是为了健康；如日后主张损失，真实病历和支出通常会逐项审查。

text.en: Report with a support person, provide the rescue and location trail, and ask for the receipt and submission list
text.zh: 由支持者陪同报案，提供求救和定位线索，并索要回执及材料提交清单

feedback.en: Confinement, threats, force, duration, injury, and sexual conduct may change the legal classification. Describe facts rather than choosing the offence label.
feedback.zh: 限制离开、威胁、强制程度、持续时间、伤情和性行为都会影响定性；应陈述事实，而不必自行确定罪名。

text.en: Tell one trusted person what you remember, mark uncertain details, and seek support before deciding about formal action
text.zh: 向一位可信任的人讲述确实记得的内容，把不确定处标明为不确定，再在获得支持后决定是否正式处理

feedback.en: A delayed decision does not erase what happened. Avoid repeated, suggestive retellings.
feedback.zh: 延后决定不会抹去发生的事；应避免反复、带暗示性的复述。

narration.en: A child says a teacher or other trusted adult called them into a room alone, kissed or touched them, and said not to tell anyone. The child is frightened and gives only short fragments.
narration.zh: 一名孩子说，老师或其他受信任的成年人把 TA 单独叫进房间，亲吻或触碰 TA，并要求不要告诉别人。孩子很害怕，只零碎地说了几句。

text.en: Say you believe them, that it is not their fault, and ask only what is needed to know whether they are safe now
text.zh: 告诉孩子“我相信你，这不是你的错”，只询问判断当前是否安全所必需的问题

feedback.en: Record spontaneous words accurately; avoid filling gaps or conducting your own repeated interview.
feedback.zh: 准确记录孩子主动说出的原话，避免补充空白或自行反复询问。

text.en: Ask the child to write or record every detail immediately so nothing is forgotten
text.zh: 请孩子立刻写下或录下所有细节，以免遗忘

feedback.en: Demanding a complete account can burden the child and shape later recall. Preserve spontaneous disclosure and seek trained help.
feedback.zh: 要求完整讲述可能加重孩子负担并影响后续回忆；应保留自发披露，并寻求专业协助。

text.en: Contact the adult privately for an explanation before telling anyone else
text.zh: 先私下联系该成年人解释，再决定是否告诉其他人

feedback.en: Early confrontation can alert the adult, expose the child to pressure, and affect records or other possible victims.
feedback.zh: 过早对质可能惊动对方、让孩子承受压力，也可能影响记录或其他潜在受害者。

narration.en: The child may still encounter the adult at school or in the community. You need to protect privacy while deciding which responsible adults and authorities should know.
narration.zh: 孩子在学校或社区仍可能接触该成年人。你需要在决定告知哪些监护人、负责人和有关机关时保护孩子隐私。

text.en: Arrange immediate separation, involve a safe guardian, and contact child-protection or police services; give them the exact disclosure without circulating it
text.zh: 先安排立即隔离，联系安全的监护人，并向未成年人保护或公安机关求助；提供孩子原话但不扩散

feedback.en: Authority, secrecy, repeated conduct, and age can be legally significant. Trained handling reduces repeated questioning.
feedback.zh: 权力关系、要求保密、重复行为和孩子年龄都可能具有法律意义；专业处理也能减少重复询问。

text.en: Notify designated school leadership in writing, request separation and preservation of access or duty records, and set a short response deadline
text.zh: 书面通知学校指定负责人，要求隔离并留存出入或值班记录，同时设定较短的书面回复期限

feedback.en: School action can address immediate access, but internal handling need not be the only route.
feedback.zh: 学校处理可先解决接触风险，但内部渠道不必是唯一途径。

text.en: Post the account in a parent group to look for other children with similar experiences
text.zh: 把经历发到家长群，寻找是否还有其他孩子遇到类似情况

feedback.en: Public circulation can expose the child, trigger pressure, spread unverified details, and complicate evidence. Use confidential channels first.
feedback.zh: 公开传播可能暴露孩子、引发压力、扩散未经核实的细节并影响证据；应优先使用保密渠道。

title.en: You separated stopping contact from preserving options
title.zh: 你把停止接触与保留选择分开处理

summary.en: Blocking, preservation, platform reporting, workplace boundaries, and legal advice can happen in different orders. The safest order depends on access, distress, and retaliation risk.
summary.zh: 拉黑、留存、平台投诉、工作边界和法律咨询可以按不同顺序进行；更安全的顺序取决于账号访问、心理压力和报复风险。

title.en: You treated the organisation's response as part of the record
title.zh: 你把单位如何回应也纳入了记录

summary.en: The conduct matters, and so do notification, investigation, interim safeguards, confidentiality, and later employment changes. Preserve facts without assuming every adverse change is retaliation.
summary.zh: 原始行为很重要，单位何时知情、如何调查、临时保护、保密方式和后续工作变化也重要；应保存事实，但不要把每个不利变化直接等同于报复。

title.en: You identified both the power imbalance and the external record trail
title.zh: 你同时识别了权力差和外部记录链

summary.en: Interview messages, hotel and staff records, trusted contacts, and prompt official requests may corroborate one another. Psychological coercion can matter even without visible restraint.
summary.zh: 面试消息、酒店和工作人员记录、可信任联系人及及时的正式请求可以相互印证；即使没有明显身体限制，心理强制也可能具有重要意义。

title.en: You preserved what existed without assuming a particular award
title.zh: 你保留了现有材料，也没有预设赔偿结果

summary.en: Original media, identifiers, immediate contacts, police records, and genuine healthcare evidence serve different purposes. Courts assess apology, mental harm, treatment, expenses, and lost work separately.
summary.zh: 原始媒体、身份线索、同期联系人、公安记录和真实医疗材料用途不同；法院会分别审查道歉、精神损害、治疗、费用和误工。

title.en: You built a record from several partial sources
title.zh: 你用多个片段构成了一条记录链

summary.en: A witness may see only the aftermath, video may show movement rather than contact, and an official decision may address another legal route. Together they may still corroborate the event.
summary.zh: 证人可能只看到事后，监控可能只拍到人员移动，正式决定也可能处理另一种法律责任；这些材料仍可能彼此印证。

title.en: You focused on escape, corroboration, and real loss records
title.zh: 你把脱离、相互印证和真实损失记录结合起来

summary.en: Calls, location, route, medical records, first disclosures, and official handling may show different parts of an enclosed-space event. Survival responses do not equal consent.
summary.zh: 求救、定位、路线、病历、首次讲述和正式处理可能分别证明封闭空间事件的不同部分；求生反应不等于同意。

title.en: The child's safety and privacy remain central
title.zh: 孩子的安全与隐私始终处于中心

summary.en: Believe without blame, record spontaneous words accurately, prevent further access, and use trained confidential channels. Do not confront through the child or circulate sexual details publicly.
summary.zh: 相信而不责备，准确记录孩子自发原话，阻止继续接触，并使用受过训练的保密渠道；不要让孩子参与对质，也不要公开传播性细节。

title.en: Support first remains a complete choice
title.zh: 先获得支持也是完整的选择

summary.en: Freezing, appeasing, leaving, blocking, waiting, or seeking care does not make the conduct your fault. Formal options can be reconsidered after safety and support, subject to the procedure and dates.
summary.zh: 僵住、顺从求生、离开、拉黑、等待或就医，都不会让侵害成为你的责任。在安全和支持之后，仍可结合具体程序和日期重新考虑正式路径。

title.en: You preserved context rather than a conclusion
title.zh: 你保存的是上下文，而不是预设结论

detail.en: Keep originals, identifiers, timestamps, surrounding messages, and a separate backup. Mark what is certain and uncertain; do not edit the only copy.
detail.zh: 保留原件、身份标识、时间、前后信息和独立备份；区分确定与不确定内容，不要编辑唯一副本。

title.en: You asked the organisation for concrete protective steps
title.zh: 你向单位提出了具体保护措施

detail.en: A traceable complaint can ask who will investigate, when, what interim separation is possible, how confidentiality works, and how retaliation concerns will be handled.
detail.zh: 可追踪的投诉可以询问由谁调查、何时完成、能否临时隔离、如何保密，以及如何处理报复担忧。

basis.en: Civil Code Article 1010 and the Women's Rights and Interests Protection Law address organisational prevention, complaint handling, investigation, and action.
basis.zh: 民法典第 1010 条和妇女权益保障法规定了单位预防、受理投诉、调查处置等义务。

title.en: You documented change without overstating its cause
title.zh: 你记录了变化，也没有过早断定原因

detail.en: Keep before-and-after schedules, evaluations, pay records, messages, and stated reasons. A qualified adviser can assess whether the pattern supports a retaliation claim.
detail.zh: 保存前后排班、考核、工资、消息和单位理由，再由专业人员判断是否支持报复主张。

title.en: You identified records that may disappear
title.zh: 你识别了可能消失的记录

detail.en: Ask the venue, employer, operator, platform, or authority what exists and how preservation works. Never assume one universal retention period.
detail.zh: 向场所、单位、运营方、平台或有关机关询问材料是否存在及如何留存；不要假定统一保存天数。

title.en: You described facts through an official route
title.zh: 你通过正式渠道陈述了事实

detail.en: Describe conduct, force, threats, inability to leave, age, relationship, safety risk, and available records. Review the statement and keep the applicable receipt or decision.
detail.zh: 陈述具体行为、强制或威胁、无法离开、年龄、关系、安全风险和现有材料；核对笔录并保留适用的回执或决定。

basis.en: Conduct may involve civil sexual-harassment liability, public-security provisions, or criminal indecent-assault rules. Reporting does not guarantee a classification.
basis.zh: 行为可能涉及性骚扰民事责任、治安管理规定或刑事猥亵规则；报案不保证特定定性。

title.en: You kept evidence of actual care and loss
title.zh: 你保留了真实照护与损失凭证

detail.en: Clinical records, payment receipts, transport evidence, and medical advice about time away from work are assessed separately. A diagnosis or estimate alone may not prove each amount.
detail.zh: 病历、缴费凭证、交通凭据和有关误工的医嘱通常会分别审查；仅有诊断或估算未必能证明每项请求。

title.en: Acting calm to escape was not consent
title.zh: 为脱身而表现平静不等于同意

detail.en: Freezing, appeasing, staying conversational, or waiting for an exit can be survival responses. They do not transfer responsibility to the person harmed.
detail.zh: 僵住、顺从、维持交谈或等待出口，都可能是求生反应，不会把责任转移给受害者。

title.en: You responded to the child without blame
title.zh: 你没有责备孩子

detail.en: Confirm safety, use the child's own words, and explain which responsible adult you need to contact. Avoid promises of absolute secrecy that you cannot keep.
detail.zh: 确认安全，使用孩子自己的原话，并说明需要联系哪位负责任的成年人；不要承诺无法做到的绝对保密。

title.en: Seeking an admission can prolong danger
title.zh: 追求对方承认可能延长危险

detail.en: A recording is not worth remaining trapped or escalating confrontation. Existing indirect records can still help; evidence collection is never an obligation.
detail.zh: 录音不值得以继续受困或升级冲突为代价；现有间接材料仍可能有用，留证从来不是受害者的义务。

title.en: The immediate boundary may leave a partial record
title.zh: 即时拉黑可能只留下部分记录

detail.en: Blocking can be necessary for safety. If only recent messages were preserved, earlier context may still exist in device backups, a platform process, or with a trusted helper.
detail.zh: 为安全拉黑可能是必要的。如果只保存了近期信息，早期上下文仍可能通过设备备份、平台流程或可信任协助者取得。

title.en: Extending contact can increase unpredictability
title.zh: 延长直接互动会增加不确定性

detail.en: Trying to capture a repeated statement may keep a person or vehicle close. Distance, identifiers, live support, and a safe destination can be more protective.
detail.zh: 为了录下重复言语而继续互动，可能让人员或车辆停留更久；距离、身份线索、实时支持和安全去处可能更具保护性。

title.en: A complete retelling should not be demanded from a child
title.zh: 不应要求孩子立即完整复述

detail.en: Preserve spontaneous words and immediate safety information. Repeated or suggestive questioning can burden the child and affect later professional interviewing.
detail.zh: 保留孩子自发原话和即时安全信息即可；反复或暗示性询问会增加负担，也可能影响后续专业询问。

title.en: Confronting the adult first can increase risk
title.zh: 先对质该成年人可能增加风险

detail.en: The adult may pressure the child, alter records, or contact other possible victims. Use safeguarding and official channels before confrontation.
detail.zh: 对方可能向孩子施压、改变记录或接触其他潜在受害者；应先使用保护和正式渠道。

title.en: Public circulation can create secondary harm
title.zh: 公开传播可能造成二次伤害

detail.en: Protect the child's identity and sexual privacy. Share only what each responsible professional needs through confidential channels.
detail.zh: 保护孩子身份和性隐私，只通过保密渠道向各负责任专业人员提供其处理所必需的信息。

realFlow.en: Reach safety first — move toward exits, staff, other people, or a trusted contact. Use 110 for immediate danger, confinement, continued following, or other urgent risk.
realFlow.zh: 先处理安全——向出口、工作人员、人群或可信任联系人移动；如有即时危险、被限制离开、持续跟踪等紧急风险，拨打 110。

realFlow.en: Preserve existing material without creating danger — original messages and media, identifiers, timestamps, route and location data, witnesses, first disclosures, and genuine medical records.
realFlow.zh: 在不制造危险的前提下保存现有材料——原始消息和媒体、身份标识、时间、路线定位、证人、首次讲述及真实医疗记录。

realFlow.en: Map external records promptly — workplace complaints, hotel or venue access, CCTV, staff incident logs, platform confirmations, police receipts, and administrative decisions may each show a different part.
realFlow.zh: 及时梳理外部记录——单位投诉、酒店或场所出入、监控、工作人员登记、平台回执、公安回执和行政决定可能分别证明不同部分。

realFlow.en: For workplace cases, record when the organisation learned of the complaint and request a traceable investigation, interim protection, confidentiality boundaries, and non-retaliation measures.
realFlow.zh: 职场情形中，记录单位何时知情，并要求可追踪的调查、临时保护、保密边界和防报复措施。

realFlow.en: For a child, believe without blame, record spontaneous words, stop further access, protect privacy, and involve a safe guardian plus trained child-protection or police services.
realFlow.zh: 涉及孩子时，相信而不责备，记录自发原话，阻止继续接触，保护隐私，并联系安全监护人及受过训练的未成年人保护或公安服务。

realFlow.en: Choose routes with advice — employer or school, platform, police, 12338, 12348, legal aid, social work, healthcare, and civil consultation serve different purposes.
realFlow.zh: 在咨询后选择路径——单位或学校、平台、公安、12338、12348、法律援助、社工、医疗和民事咨询的作用各不相同。

realFlow.en: Keep expectations evidence-based — apology, administrative action, dismissal, criminal proceedings, medical expense, lost income, and mental-distress damages each require their own support.
realFlow.zh: 对结果保持证据导向——道歉、行政处理、单位处分、刑事程序、医疗费、误工和精神损害赔偿，各自需要相应依据。

note.en: Civil Code Article 1010 addresses unwanted sexual conduct through words, text, images, or physical behaviour and provides a civil route. Organisations also have prevention and response duties.
note.zh: 民法典第 1010 条规定，违背他人意愿，以言语、文字、图像、肢体行为等方式实施性骚扰的，受害人可依法请求承担民事责任；单位也负有预防和处置义务。

term.en: Indecent assault and forced indecent assault

note.en: Classification depends on the act, force or threats, inability or fear of resisting, age, relationship, location, and evidence. Describe facts rather than self-selecting an offence label.
note.zh: 具体定性取决于行为、暴力或威胁、不能或不敢反抗、年龄、关系、地点和证据。陈述事实即可，不必自行选择罪名。

note.en: Prevention, a complaint channel, investigation, action, privacy protection, and protection against retaliation are distinct parts of an organisational response.
note.zh: 预防、投诉渠道、调查、处置、隐私保护和防范报复，是单位应对中的不同环节。

note.en: Messages, calls, location, video, access logs, witnesses, first disclosures, medical records, and official decisions may each prove only part of an event but can support one another.
note.zh: 消息、通话、定位、视频、出入记录、证人、首次讲述、医疗记录和正式决定可能各自只证明一部分，但能够相互支持。

note.en: Treatment, payment, transport, and lost-income claims are usually examined separately. Keep real records and receipts; a requested amount is not automatically awarded.
note.zh: 治疗、缴费、交通和误工通常分别审查。应保留真实记录和票据；提出的金额不会自动获得支持。

note.en: Freezing, appeasing, acting normal, delaying disclosure, or focusing only on escape are common responses. They are not consent and do not make the harmed person responsible.
note.zh: 僵住、顺从求生、表现平静、延后讲述或只专注脱身，都是常见反应；它们不等于同意，也不会让受害者承担责任。
